facts.fact: 一小时奶酪条+纸杯蛋糕才换来 Bailey 一丝笑容
facts.anchor: It’s taken an hour of making cheese straws and baking cupcakes to get a hint of a smile

facts.fact: Bailey 认出她的 ADHD 特质——像同学、也像他喜欢的 Gina（不停重新整理东西）
facts.anchor: Do you have ADHD? That friend at my school does

facts.fact: Flora 自我披露：可能有 autism+ADHD——爱秩序也爱关灯静音，感官过载会动怒
facts.anchor: I might have autism as well as ADHD

facts.fact: Bailey 替她立规矩：不许嫌她乱——她需要这样工作才舒服
facts.anchor: She needs to work like this to feel comfortable.

facts.fact: Max 小心试探 Ted：Bailey 答「大体还行，但有时候很坏」
facts.anchor: He was mostly okay, I guess. But sometimes he was mean.

facts.fact: Bailey 把刻薄当正常：「典型的爸爸行为——就想让我难堪」
facts.anchor: But that’s typical dad behaviour. It’s all about making me look bad.

facts.fact: Flora 评估：Max 像瓷器店里的牛，七个月可能不够修好父子
facts.anchor: Max is like a bull in a china shop with the way he pushes and pries

facts.fact: 她打印四份食谱还全忘带——Bailey 安慰「我们做到了，你做得很棒」
facts.anchor: But we made it work, and you did a good job
